services.name: Fishing trips
services.desc: Fishing for Striped Bass on Cape Cod is world-class! From top water, to live lining, to vertical jigging, and even fly fishing, this trip is ideal for fishermen of all experience levels, ranging from newcomers to seasoned anglers. A Striper trip is a perfect family-friendly trip for ages 5 and up. Striped Bass fishing season on Cape Cod runs from the beginning of May until the end of October, making it truly one of the top destinations for Striper spots in the country. Striped Bass on Cape Cod run from 20 inches to upwards of 60 inches long. blurb: Blue Bandit Charters offers fishing trips on Cape Cod with options including half day, full day deep sea fishing, inshore fishing charters, and coastal cruises. They fish for species such as Fluke, Flounder, Black Sea Bass, Cod, Haddock, Pollock, Striped Bass, Bluefish, Shark, and Blue Fin Tuna. The boat is a 29 foot Seavee with twin 300 horsepower engines, US Coast Guard inspected annually.
